title: The Sovereignty Archipelago
narrativeSpine: An impossible courier death and a discrepancy in interstellar transmissions connect evidence, continuity and managed public narratives across autonomous domains.
firstSceneDraft: The Sovereignty Archipelago makes political authority a problem of evidence.
A strange signal and an impossible death disturb its carefully managed future.
This investigative science fiction follows the distance between public stories and operating records.
Its appeal lies in discovering who benefits when truth arrives already arranged.
visualActionProposal: An engineer separates a ragged authentic signal from a polished public transmission; the shot descends to an accounted reservoir that should contain no body.
